import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

print("Loading data...")
# Load data with appropriate dtypes
train = pd.read_csv('/app/data/train.csv')
val = pd.read_csv('/app/data/val.csv')
test = pd.read_csv('/app/data/test.csv')

print(f"Train shape: {train.shape}")
print(f"Val shape: {val.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test.shape}")

# Identify feature types
feature_cols = [col for col in train.columns if col != 'target']
num_cols = [col for col in feature_cols if col.startswith('num_')]
bin_cols = [col for col in feature_cols if col.startswith('bin_')]
cat_cols = [col for col in feature_cols if col.startswith('cat_')]

print(f"Numerical: {len(num_cols)}, Binary: {len(bin_cols)}, Categorical: {len(cat_cols)}")

# Separate features and target
X_train = train[feature_cols].copy()
y_train = train['target'].values
X_val = val[feature_cols].copy()
y_val = val['target'].values
X_test = test[feature_cols].copy()

# Handle numerical features - fill NaN with median
print("Processing numerical features...")
for col in num_cols:
    median_val = X_train[col].median()
    if pd.isna(median_val):
        median_val = 0
    X_train[col] = X_train[col].fillna(median_val).astype(np.float32)
    X_val[col] = X_val[col].fillna(median_val).astype(np.float32)
    X_test[col] = X_test[col].fillna(median_val).astype(np.float32)

# Handle binary features - fill NaN with 0
print("Processing binary features...")
for col in bin_cols:
    X_train[col] = X_train[col].fillna(0).astype(np.float32)
    X_val[col] = X_val[col].fillna(0).astype(np.float32)
    X_test[col] = X_test[col].fillna(0).astype(np.float32)

# Handle categorical features - label encode
print("Processing categorical features...")
for col in cat_cols:
    X_train[col] = X_train[col].fillna('MISSING').astype(str)
    X_val[col] = X_val[col].fillna('MISSING').astype(str)
    X_test[col] = X_test[col].fillna('MISSING').astype(str)
    
    le = LabelEncoder()
    le.fit(X_train[col])
    X_train[col] = le.transform(X_train[col]).astype(np.int32)
    X_val[col] = X_val[col].apply(lambda x: le.transform([x])[0] if x in le.classes_ else -1).astype(np.int32)
    X_test[col] = X_test[col].apply(lambda x: le.transform([x])[0] if x in le.classes_ else -1).astype(np.int32)

print("Training model...")
# Train LightGBM model
model = LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    max_depth=-1,
    num_leaves=64,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
    verbose=-1
)

model.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Evaluate on validation set
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
val_preds = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"Validation ROC-AUC: {val_auc:.4f}")

# Generate test predictions
print("Generating test predictions...")
test_preds = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Save predictions
result = pd.DataFrame({'target': test_preds})
result.to_csv('/app/predictions.csv', index=False)
print(f"Saved {len(result)} predictions to /app/predictions.csv")
print(f"Predictions stats: min={test_preds.min():.4f}, max={test_preds.max():.4f}, mean={test_preds.mean():.4f}")
print("All predictions finite:", np.all(np.isfinite(test_preds)))
EOF
